name: A Castle Out of Place
description: A magical castle has been transported to Shandalar from another plane. Seek Dumbledore upstairs at Hogwarts, then defeat Voldemort in the northern forest. A previous castle victory counts; no return trip is required.

offerDialog.text: A castle appeared in the colorless heartlands overnight. Its visitors call it Hogwarts: a school of magic torn from another plane. Their headmaster, Dumbledore, is asking for help. Will you investigate?

epilogue.text: With Voldemort defeated, the displaced castle is safe from his immediate threat. Dumbledore's promised supplies are yours: 500 gold, 10 shards, and three random Harry Potter cards.

rewardDescription: 500 gold, 10 shards, 3 random HP cards, and +3 Hogwarts reputation

stages.name: Find the displaced castle
stages.description: Travel to Hogwarts Castle in the colorless heartlands.

epilogue.text: You have reached Hogwarts. A message for visitors directs you to Dumbledore: enter the Great Hall, take the rear-right stairs, and follow the upper gallery to his office.

stages.name: Meet the headmaster
stages.description: Speak to Dumbledore in his upstairs office at Hogwarts.

stages.name: End the threat
stages.description: Defeat Voldemort at the northern end of the Forbidden Forest. A previous castle victory counts. No return to Dumbledore or the town is needed.
